rule: Every verified MLB player (reached_mlb_verified) that was not in the 047 controlled cohort (database/research/047/development-cohort.json), derived from the production dataset on 2026-10-20 (generation 5) and ordered by the deterministic development queue: tier, Dodgers bWAR (descending, NULL last), signing year, signing date, sort name, signing id. No difficult player is excluded; difficulty produces a partial or unresolved result, never an omission.
queue_snapshot: the pre-048 state (canonical 001-047, production generation 5, source data as of 2026-10-05), ranked by the 048 pathway-aware development queue
